verdict.rationale: Event-driven triggering is implied by the documented CEL-based event filters, a Webhooks docs page, and community praise for the trigger UI. The founder confirms workflow execution paths are declared ahead of time. However, the evidence is mostly titles and passing mentions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event push/subscribe triggers from app code or queues, any evidence that one event fans out to multiple workflows/functions, substantive webhook-trigger docs beyond a page title, and hands-on corroboration.
